en: But you said you'd help.
"Count me in!" Those were your exact words.
Ngh! Fine, fine! I'm a man of my word.
Really!? Great! Thanks so much!
But you better keep your word too and make this worth my while!
Don't worry! I got it covered, buddy!
Well, I'll be waiting. I'm counting on you!
A lot of that went right over my head. See, I'm happy as long as I get to eat. But I'll think about it.
The chef's stories and emotions? I like it! I'll keep that in mind the next time I chow down!
So I won't be hungry all the time if I enjoy food more? No, it can't be that simple. But... let me think about it some more.
Er, now that I think about it, I'm not even sure why I'm here! My bad!
(I don't have anywhere to recommend right now. I'll go try a place or two before I come back.)
(Umm, which place should I tell him about?)
(Maybe I'll tell him later.)
(I'll take him to Sekai no Yamachan.)
It's this way. Follow me.
(I'll take him to Daruma.)
(I'll take him to Kaburaya.)
The mountain's bounty dwindles at this time of year, yet sustenance can be had if you look.
Was the last time you heard the voice of the mountain gods the time I appeared? What did you offer then? Maybe you should try it again.
Why don't you try leaving the same offering as last time? It was a carrot if I'm not mistaken.
The gods of the mountains favor offerings that are handmade, for it shows dedication.
Wood and tools can be bought in the village. Perhaps something could be made using them.
Do you have wood and tools? You should try to make something out of them.
Sacrifices have been offered to the gods since ancient times. Why not try something like that?
Sacrifices should be offered in a certain order. Why not try with the smallest first?
The rabbits of this mountain are fairly plentiful. Maybe you could get some rabbit meat.
Based on the process so far, you might have to sacrifice a slightly bigger animal this time.
Although you can hunt bears on this mountain, I don't think the gods expect something that big.
Bigger than a rabbit, but smaller than a bear. Hmm, on this mountain, maybe a deer?
The gods of the mountain love gorgeous things. Do you have anything glittery on you?
Since ancient times, mirrors and plates have been prized as tribute. Plates in particular have been used to pray for good harvests.
I know a glittery plate would be somewhat expensive, but maybe you could get a gold one.
Sacrifices are tragic, but long ago, they used to sacrifice village maidens. I don't think the gods want a human sacrifice these days, however.
That maidens were once sacrificed means there was something about women that the gods prized. Maybe try getting something like that.
I heard there is a publication filled with pictures of women. Maybe that's what you should offer to the gods of the mountain.
(Should be safe here. Gotta lay low till the cops are gone.)
Hey, who are you!?
People are allowed to jump right in? No one told me.
What's that? What're ya talkin' about?
Whoa, whoa, this is a big no-no. You're not supposed to be in here.
If you want to participate, you have to register and wait for the next session.
What're ya sayin'?
This is a fight arena for the snow festival.
Eh? A fight arena sounds kinda intense for a snow festival.
Let's get off the playing field and I'll explain.
The arena is for snowball fights, hahaha. If you'd like to play, I can set you up. I handle all the registrations.
Uh, that's okay. I ain't interested.
It was just an accident, me wanderin' in.
Oh. Well, if you change your mind, please come see me!
Thanks. But for now, I gotta⑬ Wait a minute.
(Can't go back to the hideout with these cops everywhere. Better kill some time here.)
Uh... Hey, how 'bout tellin' me the rules? So I can see if it's my style of competition.
Sure! Here's how you play...

You may participate in a snowball fight by speaking with the event registrar.
Each game costs 1,000 yen to play.

The participants are ranked according to the points they earn within a set time.
The winner gets a prize!

Points are awarded and subtracted as follows:

Hit an enemy with a snowball (strike): +3 Pts
Get hit by a snowball (hit): -2 Pts

Your total points will not fall below zero no matter how many times you are hit.
During the final thirty seconds, the value of hits and strikes is doubled.

You may not make your own snowballs. Acquire snowballs from the restocking points located at the four corners of the playing field.

You can fill your snowball pouch to capacity at any restocking point.

Win enough battles, and you can advance to more challenging courses
(which offer better prizes).
That about covers it. If you ever need a refresher on the rules, I'll be happy to explain again.
Here's a snowball pouch. You need it to play.
You got a <Color:8>Snowball Pouch<Color:Default>.
I'll be right here anytime you want to participate. Just let me know.
(Good, the cops are gone. Wouldn't mind a snowball fight if there's time, though.)
I'm waiting for Kazuma Kiryu-san. I've got no business with you.
Oh, so it's Kiryu-san you're looking for. Never mind, then.
Who're you?
You lookin' for Kiryu? He'll show up soon enough, no doubt.
Huh? What are you doing here?
You know Kiryu-san? Man, that guy deals with some characters⑬shady ones. Eek.
You're that girl who was with Kazuma Kiryu-san...
If you see him, do let him know I'm waiting.
(Who is this guy? Uncle Kaz sure has some odd acquaintances.)
Kazuma Kiryu-san, I presume?
I serve the Amon Clan. I came to hand you a letter.
Amon... Now there's a name I haven't heard in a while.
Take this.
You got a letter from the Amon Clan.
There. My job here is done.
Amon... Are you looking for another showdown?
Oh, it's Kiryu-san. Good. We need to talk.
It's these two. They've been giving me this look like the soul's been sucked right out of 'em. And it's all 'cause they read this weird letter.
It's getting real spooky in here, man!
What's this about a weird letter?
Ugh. Just thinking about the last time this happened makes my stomach churn. Not a good feeling.
You don't mean...
Yep. Got us a challenge from the Amon Clan.
(Them too!?)
Well, we did kind of hand them their asses not too long ago. Guess we should've known they'd be back for more.
So they sent you guys a letter as well, huh?
Ya mean to say you got one, too?
Yeah. I just got it outside.
Well, open it up.
"I'm waiting at the arena on the outskirts of town. Bring the same three as before." It's from Jo Amon. Like last time, he specified the people and the place.
Sounds about right. The letters me and Saejima-san got basically told us "tag along with Kiryu."
The other time, we were just followin' your lead. But now they took the threat directly to us. Ain't somethin' we can just let go.
Right. Considering how the Amon have operated in the past, backing out is probably not an option.
So we're doing this, then?
Yeah. I'm in.
Heh, then it's settled. We'll head out once we're all ready.
Um... guys?
So, like... I have no idea what's going on right now?
And the secret buddy-buddy talk is definitely not helping. Way to leave me out of the loop, people!
Ah. Come to think of it, I guess you wouldn't know about the Amon Clan, would you?
Nope. Hit me with some exposition. Who are these whack-jobs?
The Amon are a clan of assassins who pride themselves on being the strongest warriors alive. I've run into them more times than I care to count.
Holy balls! You took on actual <Italic>assassins</Italic> and survived!? How in the heck...?
We were around the last time he got challenged, so we're pretty much a part of this as well.
So now you're on their radar, too... Man, that's nuts. Hope you guys get 'em good.
Ya make it sound like you got nothin' to do with this.
Huh? Of course I've got nothing to do with this... Right?
Mm... Well, not directly...
Thing is, we're down one man. Anyone remember Tanimura? What happens if he doesn't show?
If anything, he probably got a challenge too. Can you get in touch with him?
Let's find out.
No dice.
Psh. He's probably out playin' mahjong.
Or he could be laying low after getting one of these letters. I would too, if I didn't kick so much butt.
Well, if we're going by the Amon Clan's instructions, we need to get ahold of Tanimura eventually. We just have to be patient.
But do we really have time to be patient? My guess is no.
Then it's settled.
...Uh-oh.
Guess this guy'll have to do.
I don't see any other options.
What!? You guys must be crazy! You want <Italic>me</Italic> to fight a clan of ninjas or assassins or whatever instead of this Tanimura dude? Yeah right!
Why, ya scared or somethin'?
Of course I'm scared⑬who wouldn't be!? There's no way I'm agreeing to that!
Well, unfortunately, you might not have a choice...
It sounds like everything is settled. Very good. A car is waiting for you just downstairs.
See? Bit too late to be backing out now.
Seriously? You're signing me up for a deathmatch!?
Better sack up quick, or ya ain't gonna make it through this.
But I can't... Kiryu-san, a little help here?
Sorry, but we can't turn back now. We have to finish this.
I don't believe it. You guys are all insane.
I assume you'll need time for preparation. Notify me when you're ready to leave.
Gah... What have I got myself into?
So you've come, Kazuma Kiryu.
Sounds like you've been waiting for me, Amon.
Yes, for far too long.
You see, once we finished our training in the abyss, we came looking for you. But you were nowhere to be found.
I must say, it wasn't easy tracking down a man who had seemingly vanished into thin air. Imagine the shock, then, to find the Dragon of Dojima driving around in a taxi.
Hope the serpent hasn't lost his bite.
You forget what happens every time you face me? Maybe you need a refresher.
Hmph. Your impudence remains unchanged, if nothing else.
Oh, and another thing...
Who is this one? In my letter I asked you to bring the same three as last time.
Uh, hi there. I'm Shinada. I work for an adult magaz⑬
So Masayoshi Tanimura is missing, then? It seems your foe has turned tail and fled, Sango.
No matter. I trust the one Kazuma Kiryu has brought in his place will be a worthy opponent.
Yeah... I'm not so sure about that...
Hmph. Now that we are all assembled... let the bloodshed begin. I assure you, we will not be humiliated again.
Guess I'd be breaking tradition if I didn't go up first. Leaves me time to watch the rest of you lay the smackdown, just like always.
All right. Be careful.
Kazuya. Know that a second defeat to the same foe would be unforgivable.
I'm well aware of the stakes. Victory shall be mine!

Whew... You were definitely tougher this time around.
Hope I didn't chip the shades too bad.
Ngh... Forgive me, Master. I've failed you...

Enough. Fall back, Kazuya. Jiro, I expect you to make up for
your elder's pitiful performance. Do not let me down.
Consider it done. I'll wipe this fool from existence.
Hey, Shinada. Hope you're warmed up, 'cause this'll be over in a minute.
Oh, no rush. I can wait.
Taiga Saejima... The last time we fought, I was merely a shadow of what I am now! Prepare to meet your end!
You got some crazy bullshit up yer sleeve, I'll give ya that. Too bad it didn't get the job done.

First Kazuya, and now you? Did you not train to the very
brink of death, all to exact your revenge? Answer me, Jiro!
Leave him be. I'll show these amateurs what our clan is really capable of.
Okay, Shinada. You got this.

Do I really..? Argh, fine! Might as well give it a shot.
Now, gotta come up with something good... Ooh, here it is.
All right, cowboy, this rodeo ain't big enough for the two of us!
...Shinada, was it? When I'm through with you, you'll wish you had never laid eyes on me. Now fight!
No...! Impossible!
Oh, what? I won?
Nice goin', bud! That was some fine fightin'!
Yeah? Heheh, thanks.
This is absurdity! No one should be able to defeat the Amon Clan... We are the ultimate fighters!
Surviving countless brushes with annihilation has tempered our strength beyond compare... So how is it we're losing!?
You say you're stronger than everybody else? Then prove it.
If you think the Amon Clan is unrivaled, then here's your chance to demonstrate it. That is, unless you're all talk.
You... know <Italic>nothing</Italic> of our tradition!
